captions.instagram:
We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites on a simulated mid-range phone, 860 of them in hospitality.

The median hospitality site took 7.5 seconds to show its main content in Google’s lab test. Across every site it was 6.9. Google calls 2.5 seconds good. Catering sites came in at 7.4, cafés at 7.2 and restaurants at 6.1.

28.3% of hospitality sites scored poor.

That is a long wait for someone checking your hours from the footpath.

captions.linkedin:
We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google Lighthouse, 860 of them in hospitality.

Median time to show the main content on a simulated mid-range phone:
Hospitality 7.5 s
All sites 6.9 s
Trades 6.6 s

Within hospitality, catering sites took 7.4 s, cafés 7.2 s and restaurants 6.1 s. 28.3% of hospitality sites scored poor, under 50 out of 100.

It is a lab test, so treat it as a warning light. But a menu or opening hours checked on the way over should not take that long to appear.

Full method: prycedigital.com/research
